entries.name: Keith Mather

expected.charges: Mutiny — for leading the October 1968 sit-down protest by prisoners at the Presidio stockade.
expected.convicted: Charged with mutiny; a fugitive in Canada 1968–1984, then court-martialed after his return.
expected.sentence: Escaped the Presidio stockade on December 24, 1968 and lived in exile in Canada for about fifteen years; arrested on his 1984 return, court-martialed, and released from Fort Ord in 1985.

entries.rationale: Amnesty International annual report 1986 page 199 explicitly places military detention in December 1984 and release in April 1985. Contemporary AP photograph dated April 10, 1985 corroborates April. A later oral history says May 10; prefer contemporary sources for month, leave exact day unresolved. This later episode arises from the 1968 case. No exact duration is inferred.
